# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b8 — Completed controller/menu regression audit

**Opt-in beta 8 for Home Assistant 2026.10+**

This beta supersedes beta 7 with two additional hardware-role fixes discovered
during the regression audit. It includes all prior beta 7 safety and menu
repairs and retains the minimal per-area devices introduced in beta 6.
Stable v0.5.1 is unchanged.

## Fixed menu and device-controller behavior

- Deselecting a device, or turning its automatic-control preference off,
  revokes its saved room actuator role and stops granting automatic commands.
  An explicitly removed thermostat also cannot receive a separately routed
  absence/OFF command. Persistent equipment safety latches remain intact.
- Enabling a fan or humidifier cannot accidentally authorize a previously
  advisory-only thermostat through the room-wide actuation switch.
- Changing an existing fan's purpose between extraction and filtration
  removes its old role. This prevents one physical fan appearing as both
  extraction and purifier equipment, which previously blocked scheduling.
- Replacing a primary climate device promotes the newly selected supported
  thermostat to primary rather than leaving it as secondary to the removed
  entity. Capability and room-ownership safeguards still apply.
- A purifier percentage is saved as `purifier_speed_percent`, the actual
  setting consumed by the fan-speed controller.
- Heat-only/cool-only equipment uses its actual HVAC mode rather than a
  fictitious dual-purpose auto mode. Setpoint controls require real supported
  HA features, humidity limits/resolution and fan speed capabilities.
- Power-control dwell and runtime selectors match the actual guarded native
  fan and humidity-power drivers, preventing invalid settings from being
  accepted by menus then rejected during operation.
- Explicitly excluded room sensors are no longer presented or accepted as
  trusted automatic-control measurements.
- Global occupied/sleep room-list sources can be cleared with the explicit
  no-source option. Switching outdoor AQI sensors refreshes the stored scale
  and limit instead of copying another sensor's selected values.

## Scope and safety

No duplicate native climate setpoint, temperature, humidity, CO2, PM or fan
control entities are added. Each enabled monitoring/control area still exposes
one compact Environment overview sensor with original source data and
calculated decisions. Optional calibrated surface RH is the sole new numeric
derived sensor.

The integration domain remains `air_quality_advisor` and original config
entries, native equipment entities, PID pause states, environmental
recommendations, Announcement Hub routing and all 38 language catalogs remain
compatible. No window actuator is controlled.

Native power and compressor-affecting behaviors remain separately opt-in and
still require physical hardware safeguards and on-device commissioning.
Unknown occupancy, stale readings and missing supported features fail closed;
automated tests are not hardware certification.

Automated release validation requires unit tests on Python 3.13 and 3.14,
front-end card tests, translation reproducibility, Hassfest and HACS. The
opt-in beta release has its own immutable tag, manual installation ZIP and
SHA-256 checksum and does not replace the stable latest channel.

## Install

Back up Home Assistant. In your custom HACS integration repository select
**Redownload → Show beta versions → v0.6.0b8**, then restart Home Assistant.
Existing users should edit their installed entry via **Configure**, not
create another integration. The attached ZIP provides manual installation
when necessary.
